name: Uniform collapse (planar)
blurb: Gas (gamma = 5/3) moving toward the plane x = 0 at a speed proportional to the distance from it, u = -x, so that all of it would arrive at t = 1. It stays uniform, with no shock: its density grows as 1 / (1 - t). The cells next to the open faces are held at the exact solution: an open face alone cannot push gas in as the collapse does, and a rarefaction would run in from it at the sound speed.
